```yaml
name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  merge_and_build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Set remote URL with token
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        run: |
          git fetch origin dev
          if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/features/hubs-recs; then
            git checkout features/hubs-recs
          else
            git checkout -b features/hubs-recs origin/dev
          fi
          git merge origin/dev --no-ff -m "Merge dev into features/hubs-recs"
          git push origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1

      - name: Build
        run: |
          if [ -f "./build.ps1" ]; then
            pwsh -File ./build.ps1
          else
            echo "No build script found, skipping build."
          fi
```
